review.reviewedBy: Manual review of manufacturer PDF page 1 and current decoder source

specifications.name: DC voltage measurement range
specifications.conditions: Below 7 V requires independent power per manual; this is measurement range, not the RS485 power supply.

specifications.name: External shunt current ratings
specifications.conditions: Select a matching external shunt and configure the meter range; not a signed current measurement.

limitations: Directional DC meter; no reliable battery-bank state of charge.
Decoder supports V/A/W; hardware integration is not verified.
